purpose: Third-party agent skills that author 2D game art from text specs (PixelSpec, SVG, rig, FX, autotile, parallax, layout) and QA it. VXPEngine vendors the code-drawn route and converts its PNG frames into RGB565 + 1-bit-mask C headers with tools/vxp_import_sprite_forge.py.
method: git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --sparse, sparse-checkout of the paths below, then the nested .git was removed so this stays a plain vendored tree
excluded: /tests (6.3 MB of upstream fixtures, needs pytest)
/tools (upstream vendor_sync.py; we do not republish upstream)
why_these_two_skills: skills/*/ never imports across skill folders - shared/forge_*.py is re-vendored byte-identically inside each skill (see shared/VENDORED.json). codeart2d is the only route usable without an image-model API key, and its --build-clips step calls ../generate2dsprite/scripts/build_animation_clips.py, so that skill folder is included for the clip bundles the importer consumes.

verification.how:
sha256 of the concatenation of '<posix path relative to third_party/agent-sprite-forge>�<sha256(file bytes)>
' for every file, records sorted by path. The exact snippet is in docs/SPRITE_FORGE_INTEGRATION.md.

engine_requirements.python: numpy + Pillow (scipy only for some matte paths); PixelSpec rendering and pixel_qa.py need nothing else
engine_requirements.optional: resvg-py / resvg-js / Chrome for SVG art only - not required by the PixelSpec route

modification_policy: The vendored tree is read-only. Engine-side behaviour lives in tools/vxp_import_sprite_forge.py; never patch upstream files in place, because they are byte-identical copies with their own digest checks.
